annotations.title: Run a command in your shell

description:
Runs one command line in a shell that hedwigai hosts for this account. It is not the user's computer: it runs only the commands hedwigai provides, which are data programs over public records and search results (SEC filings, customs bills of lading, hiring and licence filings, Google and AI-answer results), file tools (grep, jq, csv, xlsx, pdftext) and read-only views of the drives the account connected. Nothing can be written except /tmp, which with the working directory lasts for this session and is where checkout_workbook puts a workbook.

Most commands only read. These act for the account: metered programs draw on its balance (the credits tool shows it); `mail` saves email drafts, never sending them, into its connected Gmail or Outlook; `search-index` can ask search engines to index the account's own pages; `programs enable` and `programs disable` switch a program on or off; `voice`, `avatar`, `image` and `blueprint` save what they make under a link.

Run `help` to list every command, and `<command> --help` for one command's usage.

Programs: SEO and AI-search visibility: `aeo` (what ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews answer to a question, and which sites they cite), `rank`, `keywords`, `traffic`, `trends`, `search-index`. Public records: `funding` (SEC Form D raises), `company-hiring`, `h1b-hiring`, `ucc`, `fcc`, `fda`, `us-trademarks`, `us-business-license`, `us-motor-carriers`, `sec-filings`, `webcertificates`. People and companies: `outreach`, `social`, `dns`, `trade` (importers and shipments). Plus `realestate-us`, `places`, `model-prices`, `ocr`, `xlsx`, `pdftext`, `browser`.

command.description: A bash command line. Pipelines, globs and control flow work; a redirect anywhere but /tmp is refused.
